columns.name: session_id
columns.description: UUID v4 of the capture session.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: UUID v4 of the uploading user.

columns.name: user_name
columns.description: Display name of the user.

columns.name: org
columns.description: Organisation of the user.

columns.name: capture_id
columns.description: UUID v4 of the scan; joins to compositions and confidences.

columns.name: cluster_id
columns.description: UUID v4 grouping scans of the same rock cluster.

columns.name: system
columns.description: Star system.

columns.name: gravity_well
columns.description: Planet, moon or belt.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region within the gravity well, "none" if unset.

columns.name: place
columns.description: Named place, "none" if unset.

columns.name: deposit
columns.description: Deposit type, "none" if unset.

columns.name: mass
columns.description: Mass from the scan. Whole numbers, except deposits under 1 SCU (volume shown in mSCU), whose mass has decimals (e.g. 12.34): write DOUBLE for those.

columns.name: resistance
columns.description: Resistance from the scan.

columns.name: instability
columns.description: Instability from the scan.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: Volume from the scan, in SCU (the HUD shows mSCU under 1 SCU: 25.26m SCU = 0.02526).

compositions.description: One row per material of a scan.

columns.name: capture_id
columns.description: UUID v4 of the parent scan.

columns.name: mat_index
columns.description: 0-based position of the material in the scan result.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Material name.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Share of the deposit in percent, 2 decimals.

columns.name: quality
columns.description: Material quality.

columns.name: material_volume
columns.description: volume * amount / 100 of the parent scan.

columns.name: min_confidence
columns.description: Lowest OCR confidence of the row, 0..1.

columns.name: capture_id
columns.description: UUID v4 of the parent scan.
